title: Monster Substrate Centralizer 2-Adic Structure: e(p) = 17-p
theorem_statement: For each substrate prime p in {7, 11, 13}: |C_M(pA)| = 3^3 * p^2 * 2^(17-p) * extra(p)
key_insight: The 2-adic valuation of |C_M(pA)| / (27 * p^2) equals 17 - p for all three non-degenerate substrate primes. The constant 17 is the boundary prime of the substrate range and appears explicitly as a factor in extra(7) = 5^2 * 7^2 * 17.
opens: MCCXLV — Characterize extra(p) for all substrate primes
